name: Yakushiji Hime
source:
Yuu's childhood friend and classmate. She is an active girl who belongs to the field hockey club and is popular with both boys and girls.

She expresses her emotions clearly, and at times she can be a nosy busybody.

[From [url=http://www.t-apricot.jp/products/aya/chara.html]ApRicoT[/url]]
